[SWS_EM_01001] Execution Dependency error
⌈
If Execution Man-
agement needs to start Process A that depends on another Process B and Pro-
cess B is not part of the same Function Group State as Process A, then Execu-
tion Management shall return an error (and fail to start Process A).
